facts.fact: AIP reports that BNETD, through its addressing centre, launched the Projet d'adressage des villes de l'intérieur (PAVI) in Daloa on 15 January 2025, a three-year pilot of field surveys, door and street numbering and street-name signs, which also covers Bouaké and Korhogo.
